name: graceful-shutdown
prompt: main.go never shuts down cleanly: log.Fatal(http.ListenAndServe(...)) dies with requests in flight. Refactor: run the server in a goroutine, and add func shutdown(server *http.Server) error in main.go that calls server.Shutdown with a 5-second context timeout and returns the shutdown error. A live server must stop accepting, in-flight requests finish or the context expires at 5s, and calling shutdown on an already-stopped server must return no error. Keep the ListenAndServe error logged (ErrServerClosed is expected and must not log as a failure).
